tagline: Composition > Deck > Group > Layer > Clip. Click the cogwheel.

decks.name: Vocabulary
decks.world: Basic Vocabulary, drawn: the composition framed in blue, the deck as a button under the grid, the layer strips with X B S and V A M, a group bracket, a clip's green thumbnail and its name handle, a column lit top to bottom, and the render order from source to output. Charcoal panels, grid lines, light-grey labels, Resolume blue for whatever is selected and green for whatever is playing.

palette.why: Labels in Segoe UI, values in Consolas.

moments: Hierarchy: walk UP from Composition to Column one per bar with nothing lit; the blue frame shrinks to a tab, a strip, a bracket, a cell, a column.
Clip: on column 5 tap the row-2 BODY pad on the beat so the green thumbnail retriggers.
Render order: column 8, Device knob 6 (ECHO) at a third so the green pass leaves a trace down the pipeline rows.

decks.name: The Clip
decks.world: The Clips chapter, one setting per scene: Trigger Style (Normal, Toggle, Piano), Beat Snap (1/4 Bar to 8 Bars), Clip Target (Own, Active, Free Layer), Resize (Fill, Fit, Stretch, Original), Fader Start, Ignore Column Trigger (the SCOPE layer in every pack uses it), Auto Pilot and the Transition (Layer Determined at the clip, Alpha at the layer). Every option name is the manual's.
moments: Piano: Scene Launch 1, right-click the row-2 BODY clip > Trigger style > Piano, then play the pad like a key - the green cell exists only while you hold it. That is Piano.
Beat snap: Composition > Beat Snap > 1 Bar, then Scene Launch 2 and tap Scene Launch 3 off the beat; Avenue waits for the bar. Watch the amber metronome.
Fader start: column 5, turn Layer > Fader Start on for layer 3, then ride fader 3 down and up on the phrase; the green restart line jumps each time.

decks.name: Parameters
decks.world: Parameter Animation, the cogwheel's menu: Timeline with in and out points, BPM Sync in beats with Tap, Resync and Nudge, External FFT on this rig's CABLE Output with L M H bands, Gain and Fall, the Envelope's eight curves, the Dashboard's dials with In, Out, Invert and Dial Range, and Clip Position. This is the chapter every pack in this repo is built on.
moments: FFT: Scene Launch 4 and turn Track knob 3 (MID DEPTH) up until the whole picture blooms on the mids; the spectrum in column 4 already rides the signal on its own. This scene is the pack explaining its own reactivity.
Envelope: column 6, Device knob 2 (TEXTURE) at a quarter with GOUACHE lit so the elastic curve smears as it overshoots.
Dashboard: column 7, turn Device knobs 1-4 and watch the dials - they are the real links.

decks.name: Blend Modes
decks.world: Sixty-two blend modes harvested from this rig, grouped as the Blend Modes chapter groups them: General, Darken, Lighten, Contrast, Comparative, Composite and the Transitions, plus the ten '50' modes the harvest lists (the chapter documents only 50 Mask, under Composite). Each scene is two discs, A and B, overlapping, in the colours the mode would make of them. The pack itself uses Add on most layers, Screen on FIGURE, Alpha on TEXT and Overlay on AURA.
moments: A over B: on any column, ride faders 2 and 3 against each other; the discs overlap at centre.
Lighten: Scene Launch 2 with Device knob 5 (GLOW) up so Screen actually screens.
Transitions: column 8, Track knob 8 (TIME) past three-quarters so the wipe and push race.

decks.name: This Rig
decks.world: The Nerds chapter as it is set on this machine: Audio input CABLE Output for the External FFT, the APC40 mkII as MIDI in and out so the pads light, the REST API on 8080 that read every clip of every pack back, OSC on 7000 and 7001, DMA Textures on Autodetect (the manual recommends Force ON), the Defaults (Add, Timeline, Loop), the harvest itself - 22 sources, 115 effects, 1,094 parameters, 62 blend modes off 7.28.1.26535 - and Shortcut mode, where the interface turns blue.

palette.why: Panel; the last scene turns Shortcut-mode blue.
Green for live signal and the library.
Preference names and this rig's values.

moments: Audio in: Scene Launch 1 - if the input meter is flat, Preferences > Audio is not set to CABLE Output. The composition explains its own silence.
MIDI: column 2, press any pad; the pack's LED feedback is what Preferences > MIDI output is for.
Shortcut mode: UP to column 8 on the last bar, every fader up, and let the interface go blue; BLACKOUT to leave.

effect_wishlist.role: Bank A: the render pass leaving a trace down the pipeline.
Bank A: Screen and Add actually glowing.
Bank B: the envelope's elastic overshoot.
Bank C: the manual as a screen.
Bank D: a deck's grid of grids.

fft_philosophy: This pack is about the thing that makes it move, so the FFT is explicit. Deck 3 draws the spectrum, the L M H bands, Gain and Fall; Deck 5 draws the input device the whole repo depends on. Elsewhere the rule is the usual one: lows drive size and width (selection outlines, the playing cell, discs), mids drive playheads, dials and the spectrum, highs touch only the band in-point and dither. Colour never reacts: blue is selected, green is playing, amber is BPM, grey is everything else. Text never moves.
wildcard_rationale: Four decks are the manual: vocabulary, the clip, parameters, blend modes. The fifth is this rig's own Preferences as they are set tonight - the audio input, the controller, the REST port, the harvest counts - so the composition documents the machine that played it.
